note: Campground in the trees beside McLeod Lake, 6 km west of Whitecourt on Hwy 43, 11 km north on Hwy 32 and 5 km east on the access road; playground, beach, boat launch, pier and fish-cleaning stations nearby. Loops G and H sit on a narrow point between two arms of the lake. Electric motors only on Little McLeod Lake; a 12 km/h speed limit applies on McLeod Lake. --Claude
summary: Read the campground page (table, amenities, Oct 26 2026 advisories), every site on the shop and the Feb 2026 tear-sheet maps: 166 power 15/30 A C$43 + 15 walk-in tent C$35, winter FCFS in Loops G/H C$30, season 'Year-round', reservable May 14 - Sep 13, phone 780-778-2664. Wrote fees (43/43 -> 30/43), hookups, sites (200 -> 181, max 80, pull-through), facilities (+flush/vault toilets, water, dump, store), season (year_round false -> true), booking (fcfs after_cutoff -> some_sites, booking season, note). Note rewritten.
flags: PHONE (stored empty): the campground page and tear sheet give 'Information: 780-778-2664' / 'Carson-Pegasus Provincial Park Phone: 780-778-2664'. Add 780-778-2664. No Facility Operator or seniors line on the page.
WEBSITE: stored campground page and shop link both answered 200 - keep.
SEASON: stored year_round false (derived) contradicted by the page's 'Season: Year-round' - wrote year_round true.
STATUS: seasonal advisories only (booth and store closed for winter; Loops A-F closed for the season; water system off since September 14, 2026). No status written.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored not waterfront; recommend lakeview): the page itself says 'Trees offer privacy to lakeside, RV, and tent-only sites', and the shop tags G144-G147 and H170-H175 (power, pull-through, 25-31 ft) and H166 (tent) 'Near Water'. Imagery (0.36-0.4 m/px) shows Loop H's west-side pads about 25-30 m and Loop G's about 35 m from the west arm of McLeod Lake, with a continuous strip of shoreline trees and brush between - a screen, so not on-water; a thin line of trees = view. Loops A-F sit in forest behind the shore trail; E and D are the nearest to the main shore. The earlier 'not waterfront (>100 m behind a treeline)' read measured the main loops, not G/H. Recommended value: lakeview (lead for the reviewer; not raised by me).
PIN: stored 54.29025,-115.64509 sits among the main loops (A-F) on imagery and the tear sheet - OK. Loops G/H are ~500 m NW on the point.

SITE COUNT: stored 200 (derived) - the page and shop give 166 power + 15 walk-in tent = 181 individual sites (plus group areas). Six sites (D86-D88, G148, H155, H156) post 20-21 ft; the other 160 power sites take a 23-ft rig.
